title: mount.set_override, contract version 1
description: Sets a site's exception to a mount for one entry (PRD 5.8) in one changeset: hidden, the entry answers 404 at the mount's URLs while its source keeps showing it (PRD 6.6 rung 6); not hidden, the exception is taken off again and the mount shows the entry as its source does. The priority cap of PRD 5.8 is not in the command; it comes with curation. The exception is decided on the mount's node (PRD 5.10), so the issuing actor needs mount.set_override there, and a mount its grants do not reach is unauthorized. A node that is not a mount, an archived mount, an entry that does not exist, hiding an entry the mount hides already and un-hiding one it does not hide are validation_failed. A mount at another version than the caller read is version_conflict. Un-hiding an entry its source shows now or later makes that content public on the mount's site, so an agent or a token is refused with agent_visibility_forbidden. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Structure\Domain\Commands\SetMountOverride, and the generated codec SetMountOverrideCodecV1 reads it and writes its canonical JSON: every key, sorted, no whitespace.

mount.description: The id of the mount node.

version.description: The version of the mount node the caller read.

entry.description: The id of the entry the exception is for.

hidden.description: Whether the site hides the entry on the mount: true sets the exception, false takes it off.

version.description: The version of an aggregate that the caller read, an integer of 1 or more; the command is version_conflict when the aggregate is at another version when it commits.
